subject: Every string the arrange.track_headers surface exposes to AX in en-US
question: What labels does Logic show on arrange.track_headers in en-US, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in en-US whose arrange.track_headers rows carry the same 33 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: Add Tracks button. Add audio and software instrument tracks. Use tracks for recording, editing, and arranging regions.
Duplicate Track button. Create an empty track with the same settings as the selected track. Option-click to create a track with the same settings and content.
Global Tracks button. Work with global tracks to control various aspects of the overall project, such as arrangement and tempo.

Individual track zoom. Drag the track’s bottom divider line to adjust its vertical track zoom level. Command-drag to adjust all tracks of the same track type. Shift-click to reset all tracks to the default zoom level.
Input Monitoring button. Hear incoming signals on audio or software instrument tracks that aren’t record enabled. This is useful when setting levels or practicing parts before recording.
Mute button. Silence a track’s signal, audibly removing it from project playback. Corresponds to the Mute button on the channel strip in the Mixer, so that changing one also changes the other.
Name field. Double-click to rename the track.
Pan/Balance knob. Drag vertically to position the track signal in the stereo field.
Record Enable button. Prepare the track for recording, or deactivate a record-ready track. The button changes to indicate whether the track is inactive, record enabled, or currently recording.
Solo button. Isolate a track’s signal so that it can be heard without other tracks. Use on an aux or output channel strip to isolate that part of the mix.

Track header. Mute or solo the track’s channel strip signal, enable the track for recording, and adjust volume or pan. Control-click and choose Track Header Components to select which controls to show or hide.
Volume fader. Set a track’s playback volume. Use on an aux or output channel strip to adjust the volume of that part of the mix, or on the output channel strip to set the overall project volume.

conclusion: On this host in en-US, arrange.track_headers exposes 53 elements carrying 33 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.

9 window-level rows (the title bar, its close/minimise/zoom buttons and the unnamed containers directly under the window) belong to no area and are filed under no record; 0 further window rows matched no area rule. All are in the evidence file.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.
